journey.name: oversized payment amounts are refused
journey.description:
Verifies that a BIP21 payment URI whose amount is above the bitcoin supply (more than 21 000 000 BTC) is refused with the decoding error toast instead of crashing the app, whether it arrives as a deep link or is typed into the Send sheet. Also verifies that a payment link handed to the app while the Send sheet is open closes that sheet before the new payment opens, while a refused link leaves any other open sheet, such as Receive, in place. The LNURL pay and withdraw screens rely on the same close-first routing; how they behave when the send state is reset under them is covered by unit tests, because reaching them needs a Lightning spending balance the journey environment does not provide.
iOS-only: Android keeps these amounts as unsigned longs end to end and never crashed on them.
Precondition: an onboarded E2E build on regtest with the node running and at least 20 000 sats of confirmed Savings (see ../README.md). Have a valid regtest bitcoin address ready; nothing is sent, so any wallet's receive address works. Hand each link to the app with xcrun simctl openurl <simulator-id> "<uri>". Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Hand "bitcoin:<address>?amount=100000000000" to the app with xcrun simctl openurl
Verify an error toast titled "Decoding Error" appears (id "InvalidAddressToast") and the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount") does not open
Tap the "Receive" button (id "Receive") on the home screen and wait for the Receive screen (id "ReceiveScreen")
Hand "bitcoin:<address>?amount=inf" to the app with xcrun simctl openurl
Verify an error toast titled "Decoding Error" appears (id "InvalidAddressToast"), the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount") does not open and the Receive screen (id "ReceiveScreen") stays open
Close the Receive sheet and return to the wallet home screen
If a camera permission dialog appears, dismiss it by choosing "Don't Allow"
Within about two seconds, verify an error toast titled "Decoding Error" appears (id "InvalidAddressToast") and Continue (id "AddressContinue") stays disabled
Clear the recipient field (id "RecipientInput"), type the address alone and tap Continue (id "AddressContinue")
Verify the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount") is visible
Hand "bitcoin:<address>?amount=0.0001" to the app with xcrun simctl openurl
Verify the Send sheet closes, then opens again on the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount") with the 10 000 sats from the link in the amount field (id "SendNumberField")
